anomalies.observed: In the 'Water Height Sensor' block (sheet OPNhydro, page 1/1) the LiDAR module PR1 is wired pin‑for‑pin to header H1 (PB_1.25mm), and H1's pins carry global labels: pin1=+5V, pin2=GND, pin3=I2C_SDA, pin4=I2C_SCL, pin5=EZO_PDIS, pin6=GND. Thus PR1's VCC/SDA/SCL/GND/TX/RX are connected to the main +5V and I2C bus and, critically, PR1.TX (pin5) is tied to the EZO_PDIS net, which the spec says connects only U3.8, U4.8 and M1.IO6. PR1.RX (pin6) is tied to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF‑Luna LiDAR is not implemented in this revision: 'its pins are "free" and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net' (§1), 'all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design' (§4.3), and §6 'TF‑Luna LiDAR is unwired'. It also states EZO_PDIS 'ties both U3 pin 8 and U4 pin 8 ... to a single ESP32 pin (IO6/SPI_CLK)' (§4.2), i.e. that net must contain only the two PDIS pins and the MCU output.

evidence.quote: PR1 'LiDAR' pins 1‑6 wired to H1 'PB_1.25mm'; H1 right‑side labels +5V, GND, I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL, EZO_PDIS, GND (Water Height Sensor, sheet OPNhydro, page 1/1)
all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design (§4.3)
An EZO_PDIS net ties both U3 pin 8 and U4 pin 8 (PDIS) to a single ESP32 pin (IO6/SPI_CLK) (§4.2)

anomalies.impact: This build wires a module the intended design leaves unconnected. PR1.TX is an output driver now shorted onto the EZO_PDIS control net, so it contends with the ESP32's PDIS output and the ADM3260 PDIS pins, which can hold the pH/EC isolated I2C bridges powered‑down or toggle them unpredictably; PR1 also places an unintended device on the main I2C bus (and the straight pin‑to‑pin mapping mis‑aligns SDA/SCL/GND, risking a short of an I2C line to ground). The board therefore behaves differently from the intended design.

parsed.summary: The schematic deviates from the intended design by wiring the TF‑Luna LiDAR (PR1/H1) — which the specification repeatedly states is not connected to any net — onto the +5V and I2C buses and, most damagingly, onto the EZO_PDIS isolator power‑disable net, creating bus contention and an unintended I2C device.
